items.title: Freeze shared Diagnostic, exit-code, validation-helper and config entity seams
criteria: Files written are limited to: scanner/src/dogwatch/diagnostics.py, scanner/src/dogwatch/_validate.py (new), scanner/src/dogwatch/exclude.py, rules.py and contracts.py (new, entity dataclasses only), scanner/src/dogwatch/config.py (rename plus new empty-tuple fields only), scanner/tests/test_validate.py (new), test_diagnostics.py, and the construction sites/imports in test_config.py, test_report.py and test_schema.py; report.py, cli.py, output.py, scanner/schemas/**, fixtures/**, scanner/tests/golden/** and conftest.py are unchanged

Diagnostic has exactly the fields (source, id, severity, message) with id typed str and a Severity literal; diagnostics.py defines Final[str] constants CONFIG_NOT_FOUND, CONFIG_INVALID, EXCLUDE_UNMATCHED and SOURCE_SYNTAX_INVALID; every config-time Diagnostic construction in config.py uses source="dogwatch" and severity="error"
render_diagnostics([]) == ""; render_diagnostics(ds) == "".join(f"dogwatch:{d.id}: {d.message}\n" for d in ds); render(err) == render_diagnostics(err.diagnostics)
EXIT_OK == 0, EXIT_GATE_FAILED == 1 (comment says emitted, not reserved), EXIT_ERROR == 2

test_validate.py shows is_kebab_id accepts 'a', 'no-db-in-domain' and a 64-character id and rejects a 65-character id, 'A', 'a_b', 'a:b', '-a' and 'a--b'; is_identifier rejects 'class', 'foo-bar' and ''; key-path rendering yields 'python.rules[1].targets[0]'; typed accessors produce the existing '<path> is required' and '<path> must be a string' wording; config_invalid(message) returns a DogwatchError carrying one config-invalid diagnostic

PolicyConfig is renamed to DogwatchConfig with no alias; load_policy returns a DogwatchConfig whose exclusions, rules and contracts are all (); every pre-existing test_config.py assertion passes with unchanged messages

ExclusionDecl, RuleDecl (kind-discriminated with DC-C4 defaults) and OpenApiContractDecl exist as frozen dataclasses in exclude.py, rules.py and contracts.py, which import only the stdlib and contain no parse functions; _validate.py imports only dogwatch.diagnostics
The import allowlist in test_config.py::test_config_module_restricts_imports_and_os_calls admits dogwatch.exclude, dogwatch.rules and dogwatch.contracts and passes
Zero behaviour change: make test-fixtures passes with byte-identical 0.1 goldens (git diff --exit-code fixtures scanner/schemas is clean)
make test-scanner, make lint-scanner and make test-fixtures all exit 0 (checkpoint CP0)

evidence: Accept. The seam-foundation slice meets every contract criterion when checked against the branch. Diagnostic now has four fields and diagnostics.py defines the id constants and render_diagnostics. EXIT_GATE_FAILED is now commented as emitted. The _validate helpers, the frozen entity dataclasses and the PolicyConfig→DogwatchConfig rename (no alias) are in place, and the goldens and schemas are untouched. The recorded lint, mypy and pytest runs (226 passed) are all green. report.py changes by two lines (the import and the annotation). Criterion 6 forces that change, and the developer cites the operator's choice for it.
I inspected the branch diff against the base with git_inspect (--stat), and read config.py and cli.py as they are on the branch.
Verification attempt 2 ran in the task worktree: ruff exit 0, mypy exit 0 (27 files), and pytest 226 passed, which includes tests/golden/test_fixture_goldens.py (9) and test_validate.py.
The 'inconclusive' disposition is resolved by reading the code: every criterion is backed by inspected code and passing tests.

Ticket coverage: this seam slice prepares AC-2 (the declaration entities for packages, exclusions, rules and contracts) and AC-4 (distinct diagnostic ids and exit-code semantics). It does not finish them yet. It adds nothing outside the ticket.

items.title: Implement exclusion glob syntax validation, matcher and package-tree walk
criteria: Files written are limited to scanner/src/dogwatch/exclude.py and scanner/tests/test_exclude.py (new); the ExclusionDecl fields frozen by seam-foundation are unchanged

parse_exclusions(value: object) -> tuple[ExclusionDecl, ...] raises DogwatchError with exactly one config-invalid diagnostic whose message follows the IC-ERR-4 template and contains python.exclude[i] for each case: exclude not an array, non-string entry, empty pattern, leading '/', a '.', '..' or empty segment, and '?', '[' or '\' in a pattern

Matcher tests: 'src/shop/**/*.py' matches 'src/shop/a.py' and 'src/shop/x/y/b.py'; 'src/shop/*.py' does not match 'src/shop/x/b.py'; 'a**b' behaves like 'a*b'; matching is case-sensitive; two overlapping patterns are each satisfied by the same file

check_matches(config_dir, packages, exclusions) walks with os.scandir using is_file/is_dir(follow_symlinks=False) and normpath'd '<root>/<name>/<rel>' candidates; a pattern matching only a directory, only a file outside <root>/<name>/, or only a symlink (to file or directory) yields exclude-unmatched with message "python.exclude[i] '<v>' matches no file under a declared package directory"; several unmatched patterns yield one diagnostic each in config order
With open and os.scandir instrumented, check_matches never calls open and calls os.scandir only on paths whose realpath lies under some realpath(<config_dir>/<root>/<name>)

packages is typed against a module-local typing.Protocol with read-only name: str and root: str (no import of dogwatch.config, including under TYPE_CHECKING); exclude.py imports only the stdlib, dogwatch._validate and dogwatch.diagnostics
make test-scanner, make lint-scanner and make test-fixtures exit 0

evidence: Accept. exclude.py adds parse_exclusions, which raises a single config-invalid error per bad entry, plus a case-sensitive glob matcher and check_matches. check_matches walks only the declared package directories without following symlinks, uses normalized candidate paths, and reports one exclude-unmatched diagnostic per unmatched pattern in config order. Tests in test_exclude.py cover every listed case, including instrumented open/os.scandir checks and the import and Protocol guards. The recorded ruff, mypy and pytest runs (286 passed) are green. The one file outside the allowed list is a separate one-line commit to test_validate.py. The contract made it unavoidable, because the old guard forbade exclude.py from defining functions. No command checks the case where a package directory is missing.
Read the branch head b4da9b2 in the task worktree. git status is clean, and _validate.config_invalid/key_path and diagnostics.EXCLUDE_UNMATCHED are as cited.
verification_disposition is 'inconclusive', but verification attempt 2 records ruff, mypy and pytest (286 passed) all exiting 0.

The test_validate.py edit falls outside criterion 1's file list. It is accepted because the contract required it (the old guard forbade functions in exclude.py) and the run log shows an operator escalation that matches the stated authorization.
Ticket mapping: this slice moves AC-1 (exclusion config is validated with precise diagnostics) and AC-2 (explicit exclusions in a valid config).

items.title: Implement named forbid/layers rule validation
criteria: Files written are limited to scanner/src/dogwatch/rules.py and scanner/tests/test_rules.py (new); the RuleDecl fields frozen by seam-foundation are unchanged

parse_rules(value: object) -> tuple[RuleDecl, ...] checks in order: kind, per-kind unknown keys, required fields and types, id grammar, id uniqueness, non-empty reason, selector syntax, structural constraints

test_rules.py has one test per Edge Case 'Rules' case (missing id/kind/reason through unknown keys inside a rule, including the other kind's keys rejected for each kind and except_sources given without sources) asserting id == 'config-invalid', the exact key path in the message (e.g. python.rules[1].targets[0]) and the IC-ERR-4 template text

Valid inputs load: forbid with all optional keys; forbid with only targets (sources == ()); layers with exhaustive = true and container; layers without container (exhaustive is False, container is None); fields of the other kind keep DC-C4 empty defaults
parse_rules(None) and parse_rules([]) both return ()
A selector naming no existing module is accepted and no filesystem access occurs (open/os.scandir/os.stat instrumented)
Every failure raises exactly one diagnostic
rules.py imports only the stdlib, dogwatch._validate and dogwatch.diagnostics
make test-scanner, make lint-scanner and make test-fixtures exit 0

evidence: Accept. parse_rules in rules.py runs the checks in the IC-PY stage-2b order, structural checks included (descendant, then prefix, then duplicate, then container). Each failure raises one config-invalid diagnostic, and the messages match the IC-ERR-4 rule templates word for word. test_rules.py covers every case in the frozen-spec 'Rules' edge-case list, plus the valid-load, empty, no-filesystem-access and import-guard criteria. The recorded ruff, mypy and pytest runs passed (354 tests). The one extra file, test_validate.py, is a separate one-line commit (4978c66) that the operator authorized under option A of the validator-guard escalation.
Worktree at 4978c66 is clean (git status shows no changes); the commits are 8d6761e (rules.py + test_rules.py) and 4978c66 (test_validate.py:204 only).

The IC-ERR-4 rule rows (architecture_contracts.md:200-216) were compared with the messages in rules.py. They match word for word, including the kebab regex text, 'duplicates python.rules[j].id', 'overlaps … layers[k]' with j>k, and 'container is required when exhaustive = true'.

The IC-PY stage-2b row (architecture_contracts.md:107) gives the order kind → unknown keys → required/types → id grammar → uniqueness → reason → selectors → structural (descendant, prefix, duplicate, container). rules.py _rule/_check_layers follow it, and test_rule_checks_run_in_contract_order pins it with 11 cases that each contain two defects.

Frozen-spec Edge Cases 'Rules' (frozen_spec.md:156) was checked item by item against the test_rule_edge_case_rejected ids. Every listed case is present, including except_sources without sources (CQ-2 default) and the layer equal to the container.

_validate.py helpers were read: table_array, require_str, optional_str_list and optional_bool each raise a single-diagnostic DogwatchError through config_invalid, so a failure always produces exactly one diagnostic.

Operator authorization for 4978c66: events.jsonl records the option (A) escalation decision, which covers exclude-, rules- and contracts-validation and allows each to drop its own module name from the guard parametrize in a separate commit. The accepted precedent is b4da9b2.

verification_disposition 'inconclusive' was adjudicated by reading the code. The recorded tool_runtime attempt 2 shows ruff check, mypy (29 files) and pytest (354 passed) all exit 0. The developer reports the make targets passing (345 passed, 9 deselected, plus 9 fixture tests); this is consistent with the make target deselecting marked tests.
Security (OWASP): parse_rules is pure in-memory validation with no I/O, eval or dynamic import; the no-filesystem-access test confirms this. Nothing relevant was found.

items.title: Implement optional OpenAPI contract declaration validation
criteria: Files written are limited to scanner/src/dogwatch/contracts.py and scanner/tests/test_contracts.py (new); the OpenApiContractDecl fields frozen by seam-foundation are unchanged; unknown keys inside a contract entry are not checked here

parse_contracts(value: object) -> tuple[OpenApiContractDecl, ...] checks id presence, type, is_kebab_id and uniqueness; path presence and type; path syntax (relative, '/' separators, no '.', '..' or empty segment, no '\', extension .yaml/.yml/.json case-sensitive); and textual path uniqueness

test_contracts.py has one test per case (missing id, missing path, duplicate id, duplicate path, bad extension, absolute path, '..' segment, backslashes, '.' segment) asserting config-invalid, a message containing openapi.contracts[i] (or [j] for duplicates) and the IC-ERR-4 template text
A contract whose path does not exist loads successfully and the module performs no filesystem access (instrumented open/os.scandir/os.stat)
parse_contracts(None) and parse_contracts([]) return ()
contracts.py imports only the stdlib, dogwatch._validate and dogwatch.diagnostics, never dogwatch.rules
make test-scanner, make lint-scanner and make test-fixtures exit 0

items.title: Wire staged load_policy validation over the full accepted config surface
criteria: Files written are limited to scanner/src/dogwatch/config.py, scanner/tests/conftest.py and scanner/tests/test_config.py; diagnostics.py, _validate.py, exclude.py, rules.py, contracts.py, report.py, cli.py, scanner/schemas/**, fixtures/** and scanner/tests/golden/** are unchanged

load_policy implements stage 2a (unknown keys across top level, [python], [openapi], package entries and contract entries, collected and sorted, first reported), stage 2b in fixed order (python type, packages with keyword names rejected, parse_exclusions, parse_rules, openapi type, parse_contracts), stage 3 aggregated package filesystem checks prefixed 'python.packages[i]: ', and stage 4 check_matches only when exclude is non-empty

load_policy succeeds on a full-surface config built in tmp_path (packages, exclude, one forbid rule, one layers rule, one contract) and on variants without contracts, without rules, without exclude, and packages-only

Each of python.type_checking, python.clock, python.max_waiver_days, python.waivers, a baseline key, openapi.severity, an unknown top-level key, an unknown package-entry key and an unknown contract-entry key is rejected as '<key path> is not supported in this version'; with several unknown keys the reported one is sorted(K)[0]

Every Edge Case 'Config file' and 'Packages' case produces the IC-ERR-4 message; preserved CD-5 texts are verbatim and stage-3 messages carry the 'python.packages[i]: ' prefix; a keyword package name such as 'class' is rejected

Fail-fast staging: unknown key plus missing package directory yields exactly one (unknown-key) diagnostic; a stage-3 defect plus an unmatched exclusion yields only stage-3 diagnostics; every document-stage failure yields exactly one diagnostic
Every raised diagnostic has source 'dogwatch' and severity 'error'; every returned DogwatchConfig satisfies the DC-C1 to DC-C5 predicates

Trust tests: open is called only on config_arg; os.scandir is called only under package directories and zero times when exclude is absent or empty; the config.py import and os-call restriction test is updated and passes
Through the existing CLI entry point, a config with an unmatched exclusion exits 2, writes no report, and prints a matching 'dogwatch:exclude-unmatched: ...' stderr line
make test-scanner, make lint-scanner and make test-fixtures exit 0 with the fixtures/minimal golden unchanged (checkpoint CP1)

items.title: Implement report model 0.2, schema pin, status-derived CLI exit codes and minimal golden
criteria: Files written are limited to scanner/src/dogwatch/report.py, scanner/src/dogwatch/cli.py, scanner/schemas/report-0.2.schema.json (new), deletion of scanner/schemas/report-0.1.schema.json, scanner/tests/test_report.py, test_schema.py, test_cli.py, appended render tests in test_diagnostics.py, scanner/tests/golden/test_fixture_goldens.py and fixtures/minimal/expected-report.json (only via make regen-fixtures); diagnostics.py, config.py, _validate.py, exclude.py, rules.py, contracts.py, conftest.py, output.py, golden/harness.py, golden/regenerate.py, fixtures/minimal/dogwatch.toml, fixtures/minimal/src/**, fixtures/README.md and test_trust_boundary.py are unchanged
build_report returns exactly the keys {schema_version: '0.2', status, scanner, policy, findings, diagnostics}; FORBIDDEN_FIELDS keys are absent; provenance fields are present

derive_status: an error diagnostic gives 'inconclusive'; otherwise an error finding gives 'fail'; error finding plus error diagnostic gives 'inconclusive'; warning/info entries alone give 'pass'; exit_code_for_status maps pass/fail/inconclusive to 0/1/2
Finding keys are exactly the DC-R3 set with waiver always null; locator contains no null values; Diagnostic keys are exactly the DC-R5 set
Serialization is canonical with a trailing newline and literal non-ASCII; any permutation of findings and diagnostics serializes to identical bytes; repeated serialization is byte-identical

report-0.2.schema.json has $id 'urn:dogwatch:schema:report:0.2' and validates constructed pass, fail, both inconclusive kinds, non-ASCII, warning/info and all-optional-locator reports; it rejects a forbidden field, a non-null waiver, a Finding with an 'id' key and a Diagnostic with a 'check_id' key; rg 'report-0\.1' scanner finds no matches

test_cli.py produces and asserts the (report present, status, exit) tuple for: policy violation via monkeypatched dogwatch.cli.scan returning an error finding -> (True, fail, 1); invalid source syntax via an error source-syntax-invalid diagnostic -> (True, inconclusive, 2); adapter failure via an error diagnostic with source 'openapi' -> (True, inconclusive, 2); malformed config via missing or invalid-TOML file end to end -> (False, none, 2); the four tuples are pairwise distinct and each written report validates against schema 0.2
stderr lines equal 'dogwatch:<id>: <message>' for each report diagnostic in report order, rendered after a successful write, and stderr is empty when there are none

On report write failure no diagnostic lines appear, the last stderr line starts with 'dogwatch: error: cannot write report to ', exit is 2 and no temp file remains; with the same-file guard triggered scan is called zero times and the config file is unchanged; --version, stdout '-' mode and usage errors behave as before
dogwatch.cli.scan is module-level, looked up at call time, takes one parameter and scan(cfg) == ((), ())

test_fixture_goldens.py pins SCHEMA_PATH to report-0.2.schema.json and asserts each golden has status 'pass' and diagnostics == []; make regen-fixtures rewrites only fixtures/minimal/expected-report.json to the 0.2 shape
make test-scanner, make lint-scanner and make test-fixtures all exit 0, including repeated-run and TZ/LC_ALL/HOME/PYTHONHASHSEED golden variants (checkpoint CP2, no red window)

items.title: Add full-surface golden fixture, trust-boundary and module-structure tests, and run the final gate
criteria: Files written are limited to fixtures/full-surface/** (new, static, LF endings, never imported), fixtures/README.md, scanner/tests/test_trust_boundary.py and scanner/tests/test_module_structure.py (new); scanner/src/**, scanner/schemas/**, scanner/tests/golden/**, conftest.py, test_config.py, test_cli.py and fixtures/minimal/** are unchanged

fixtures/full-surface/dogwatch.toml declares at least one package, at least one exclude pattern matching at least one real regular file under <root>/<name>/, at least one forbid rule, at least one layers rule and exactly one [[openapi.contracts]] whose checked-in spec file exists; load_policy on it succeeds

make regen-fixtures creates fixtures/full-surface/expected-report.json with schema_version '0.2', status 'pass', findings [] and diagnostics []; afterwards git diff --exit-code fixtures/minimal is clean
make test-fixtures passes for both fixtures: byte-exact goldens, identical repeated runs, TZ/LC_ALL/HOME/PYTHONHASHSEED variants with no environment leakage, and schema 0.2 validation of every golden

test_trust_boundary.py: on fixtures/minimal, os.scandir, os.listdir and open are never used on package directories; on fixtures/full-surface, os.scandir is used only under package directories and no file there is opened; in both, no module named after a fixture package appears in sys.modules and a fixture source file that raises on import does not change the outcome; the network-disabled run still passes
fixtures/README.md documents the full-surface fixture and its regeneration rule

test_module_structure.py (AST-based) asserts: diagnostics imports no dogwatch.* module; _validate imports only diagnostics; exclude, rules and contracts import only _validate and diagnostics and never each other; config does not import report or cli; report does not import cli, exclude, rules or contracts; the import graph is acyclic; test_isolation.py stays green
Final gate: make test-scanner && make lint-scanner && make test-fixtures pass in one run, and make run-scanner exits 0 with empty stderr (checkpoint CP3)
